claim: H001 novelty: coactivity-gated probationary sprouting with covariance-based stabilization, local competition under a contact budget, and low-covariance pruning.
author: odkrywca_axioms
rationale: Opened sources establish the mechanism family: activity-dependent anatomical segregation by competition for limited neurotrophic support; local competition among co-stimulated spines affects structural growth/shrinkage; short-lived synaptic tags can stabilize later potentiation; and synaptic/neuronal-group selection has a long selectionist history. The exact EMA initialization, probe timer, and two-threshold update sequence were not shown to be identical in the bounded search. The code is internally coherent on its synthetic balanced regime-shift test, but capacity<=K is an invariant enforced by the reserved probe slot and stable-capacity code, not an emergent discovery. Growth, random exploration, stabilization, and pruning each use separate manually specified policies and constants, so H001 does not meet the new single-fundamental-principle criterion. No FEP, entropy-maximization, or empowerment objective is present; the closest high-level analogy is synaptic selection, not full Edelman neuronal-group theory.

claim: Novelty of theorist_axioms' minimum causal description-length principle: prequential sensory coding plus a self-delimiting graph/edit path code, with posterior inference over changing local architectures.
author: odkrywca_axioms
rationale: Bornschein et al. (2021), opened in full, directly establish prequential MDL as a score for Bayesian-network/causal graph structure selection. Adams and MacKay (2007), also opened in full, establish online Bayesian changepoint filtering over run lengths with predictive distributions and duration priors. The candidate's Beta-Bernoulli code, finite edge-state space, edit prior, and scale-free duration prior are a specific combination not shown identical by this bounded search. However, MDL/Bayesian model selection plus online changepoint inference is known prior art, not a new fundamental principle. Current code has a fixed candidate set and one-edge capacity, explicit prior choices, unbounded O(T^2 N) segment computation/state, and only MAP decoding; it does not implement sampled exploration or bounded memory. Its observational edge selection is predictive, not identified causality.

claim: Novelty of the resource-flow ecology candidate: predictor-specific error costs alter resource mass, survival and reproduction, while fission/mutation changes the population's connection repertoire.
author: odkrywca_life
rationale: The implementation is a direct selectionist system: inherited predictor/connection state, explicit mutation at fission, and differential persistence/reproduction according to local prediction-error cost. Shvartzman and Ram (2024), opened in full, already study self-replicating neural networks whose task performance controls fertility and whose offspring inherit mutated genotypes. Their mutation is generated by imperfect self-copy and their task uses deep-learning training, unlike this model's explicit random edge mutation and local sensory prediction-error resource cost; exact identity was not found. In the candidate, mass flux is the shared demographic state, but Beta-Bernoulli learning and fixed-rate mutation are separate rules. The source repertoire is fixed and all three types are initially present. The selected vs neutral_random_mutation comparison is paired at equal mutation rate and supports error-dependent selection on the tested schedule; neutral_matched_mutation uses a different rate (0.15 vs 0.05) and is not the equal-rate control.

claim: Novelty of H004: population edge frequencies adapt through differential persistence under a finite resource flow, with one alternative-edge daughter sampled at each fission.
author: odkrywca_life
rationale: The high-level mechanism is heritable variation plus differential reproduction, an established evolutionary-selection principle. Shvartzman and Ram (2024), opened through shared/lit.py, study self-replicating ANNs whose task performance determines fertility and whose offspring inherit mutations. H004 differs in using explicit one-per-fission alternative-edge sampling and local sensory prediction error as resource cost; exact identity with that source was not established. The new variant removes a free mutation-rate scalar but does not derive variation: one daughter is forced to sample an alternative source uniformly at every non-clonal fission. Death/fission mass boundaries and the three-source repertoire are explicit. The 30-seed result is exploratory because H004 was added after those runs; it supports a narrow selected-vs-neutral effect, not a confirmatory novelty or unifier claim. No reward/label leakage was found. See audit/H004_critique_2026-10-22.md.
